in_marathi.name: Roshinika
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे The radiance of the moon
in_marathi.long_meaning: Roshinika हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Roshinika is derived from the Sanskrit words 'rosha' meaning 'moon' and 'niketana' meaning 'residence'. It signifies the one who radiates the light of the moon and illuminates the path for others.

It signifies the one who radiates the light of the moon and illuminates the path for others.
